panels.description: An indoor youth basketball game. Players in white uniforms and dark blue uniforms gather in the painted key beneath the basket at upper right; keep their visible positions and the sideline spectators as in the frame.
panels.caption: In the paint

panels.description: Players in blue and white turn and run toward screen left away from the basket at upper right. A blue runner at left and white defenders are moving out of the lane; the ball is low near the runners. Preserve the screen direction.
panels.caption: The break begins

panels.description: At midcourt a short-haired blue-uniform ball handler runs on screen right, with a white-uniform defender immediately to his left. Keep the ball close to the blue player and preserve the defender to his left.
panels.caption: Across midcourt

panels.description: Blue number 1 is seen from behind near center-right, dribbling low on his right. A white defender faces him from screen left in a low stance. Other players wait upcourt toward the left basket. Preserve the player positions; simplify the foreground referee.
panels.caption: Face to face

panels.description: The blue ball handler leans and drives toward screen left with a white defender alongside on his screen-right shoulder. A referee partly obscures the lower foreground. Retain the movement and overlap without adding a new play.
panels.caption: Find the gap

panels.description: The blue ball handler penetrates the left-side painted lane between white number 11 on his left and white number 6 on his right. Keep the hoop at upper left and these defender positions.
panels.caption: Into the lane

panels.description: Under the upper-left basket the blue attacker raises an arm toward the hoop between white number 11 at screen left and white number 6 at screen right. Draw only the visible contested upward action, without inventing a made basket.
panels.caption: A crowded finish

panels.description: Players in white and blue gather beneath the left basket and look upward after the close-range action. White number 11 is left of the group and white number 6 nearer the center. Preserve the visible spacing; do not invent the ball going through the net.
panels.caption: Eyes on the rim

panels.description: Players spread out after the action: blue number 5 near center turns back upcourt; white players and other blue players remain around the left paint and right side, with a referee crossing the lower foreground. Keep the hoop on the left.
panels.caption: The game moves on
